subject: Learning Methods
title: The Whiteboard Test
description: A 60-second lesson on The Whiteboard Test.

hook.text: Engineers at Google use whiteboard explanations to test understanding. If you can't draw it on a board, you don't know.

buildup.text: A whiteboard limits you to key ideas and their relationships. No hiding behind paragraphs of text. Just structure.

discovery.text: Drawing forces spatial organization. You must decide what goes where, what connects to what, and what matters most.

twist.text: People who can fill a whiteboard with accurate content and connections score higher on transfer tests than those who.

climax.text: After studying, grab a blank paper. Draw the concept map from memory. Every blank space reveals a gap to fill.

punchline.text: Empty paper. No notes. Draw what you know. Gaps appear.

quiz.question: Why is the whiteboard test an effective learning tool?
options: Whiteboards are available in every classroom
It forces spatial organization and exposes gaps in understanding
Drawing activates the creative hemisphere of the brain
